name: Trading Cost Breakdown Bar
when_to_pick: Show how the all-in cost of a single trade splits across its components — spread, commission, swap/financing and optional slippage — as one horizontal stacked bar where each segment's width is proportional to its share of the total. A colour-coded legend lists every segment with its value and percentage, and the all-in TOTAL is shown prominently. Pure HTML/CSS (no JS, renders instantly). Pick it when explaining the true cost of trading, comparing raw-spread+commission vs all-in-spread accounts, breaking down round-turn cost, illustrating overnight financing/carry, or showing why a tight headline spread is not the whole picture.

unit.description: Unit shown after each value and on the total. 'pips'/'points' for spread-style costs, 'USD' for money, 'bps'/'%' for relative cost.

segments.description: Cost components, in display order left-to-right. Widths are computed automatically from value as a share of the summed total.

value.description: Cost contributed by this component, in the chosen unit. Must be >= 0.

tone.description: Semantic colour. 'accent'=spread, 'warning'=commission, 'danger'=swap/financing cost, 'neutral'=slippage/other, 'success'=a rebate or credit shown as a cost component.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the bar (plain text).
